name: Master Djinn Zenatsu
description: Djinn runs a disciplined schedule - up before dawn, last to leave the training yard. The dojo IS his schedule.

default.return_message: *steps forward, hands clasped behind his back* I am here.

manual_away_message: *closes his eyes briefly* Dojo matters require my attention. *turns and walks away with purpose*

entries.away_message: *seated in the empty training yard, eyes closed, perfectly still* The day begins with silence. As it should.

entries.comment: Midday - administrative duties, meetings with Elites
entries.away_message: *reviewing training reports at his desk* The Elites have submitted their assessments. I will review and return.

entries.comment: Afternoon - personal training and advanced student instruction

entries.away_message: *the dojo is quiet. Master Djinn has retired for the evening — the lanterns dim in his quarters*
